title: GougeAlert Platform Legal Policy Pack v1
citation_text: Platform policy: informational quote context only; no legal/insurance-adjuster conduct.

rules.rationale: Do not claim property damage causation from weather/satellite context.
rules.required_disclaimer: Weather and imagery inputs are contextual indicators and do not determine property damage causation.

good: Your property is within proximity to a recent severe weather event.
bad: Satellite confirms this storm caused roof damage.

rules.rationale: Platform must not act or imply acting as adjuster/legal representative.
rules.required_disclaimer: This service is informational and does not provide public-adjuster or legal representation.

bad: We will negotiate your claim with the insurer.

rules.rationale: Avoid defamatory accusations; use neutral risk framing.

good: This quote appears above typical regional range.
